state.objective: Break a near tie between reviewing tax/prepaid/accrual accounts and reviewing legacy interunit accounts next. Choose review priority, not final accounting treatment.
confirmed_operating_model: One centralized retail company with HO and operating units/sites.
Units are not separate finance centers and cannot transact directly with other units; finance is controlled by HO.
Unit/site has already been removed from natural GL suffixes and is recorded as site_id.
No general counter_site_id or related_site_id will be added.
Operational HO-unit shipments can use origin/destination fields on transfer documents.
It is not yet confirmed whether all locations belong to one legal entity or whether any balances involve separate legal entities/affiliates.

details: Nine prepaid-expense families: insurance, land rent, store rent, house rent, maintenance contracts, vehicle rent, promotion, business permits, other.
Eleven tax asset/liability families: six prepaid tax types and five tax payable types.
One unresolved Current Tax Inc/Exp PPh 25 family.
Ten accrued-expense/YMHD families: payroll, THR/bonus/severance, loan interest, medical, insurance/BPJS, telephone, electricity, water, store rent, house rent.
Four advance families: travel, purchase, contractors, others.
candidate_A_tax_prepaid_accrual.main_risk: Different tax rights/obligations and different expense natures may need separate natural accounts even when schedules provide detail.

details: Forty-two receivable families: 14 named locations for each of Financing, Goods, and Other affiliate receivables.
Twenty-eight payable families: 14 named locations for each of Financing and Goods affiliate payables.
candidate_B_legacy_interunit.main_risk: The names suggest affiliate/interunit balances, but the stated process says HO-unit only and no unit-to-unit activity. Legal-entity status, historical postings, settlement and eliminations are unknown.

state.prior_result: Previous Jev choice was tax/prepaid/accrual 0.48 versus interunit cleanup 0.43, confidence 0.32.
state.rule: Prioritize the domain where review is most likely to prevent a structurally wrong target design or expose obsolete/misused accounts. Do not choose solely by number of families.

legal_entity_dependency.instructions: Which domain has the stronger dependency on confirming whether sites are the same legal entity?

criteria.interunit: Receivable/payable and elimination treatment changes fundamentally with legal-entity status.
criteria.tax: Tax/prepaid/accrual structure changes more fundamentally from site legal status.

operating_model_conflict.instructions: Which domain shows a more direct conflict between legacy COA structure and the confirmed HO-unit operating model?

criteria.interunit: Seventy location-specific affiliate receivable/payable accounts conflict with no unit-to-unit finance unless justified by legal entities or legacy clearing.
criteria.tax: Tax/prepaid/accrual accounts conflict more directly with HO-unit centralization.

risk_if_deferred.instructions: Which review is more important before designing posting workflows for HO and units?

criteria.interunit: Clarify whether HO-unit movements create internal clearing, receivable/payable, branch accounting, or no balance-sheet claim.
criteria.tax: Compress tax schedules first even while HO-unit settlement logic remains unknown.

compression_readiness.instructions: Which domain is more ready for safe compression based on names alone?

criteria.neither: Both require policy, transactions, balances and reconciliation.
criteria.interunit: Seventy location names alone prove the correct mapping.
criteria.tax: Tax labels alone prove they can share one account.

audit_priority.instructions: Which domain should be audited first to determine whether accounts are valid, obsolete, or structurally misused?

criteria.interunit: Audit legal entity, counterparty, settlement and elimination behind 70 legacy families first.
criteria.parallel: Both must be audited simultaneously before any progress.

implementation_dependency.instructions: Which decision has more impact on core document and posting architecture?

criteria.interunit: Determines internal transfer, due-to/from, branch/legal-entity and elimination architecture.
criteria.tax: Determines tax codes, schedules and accrual postings but not internal transfer architecture.

recommended_sequence.instructions: Choose the next two-step review sequence given all supplied facts.

criteria.interunit_then_tax: Resolve legal-entity and HO-unit clearing first, then tax/prepaid/accrual schedules.
criteria.tax_then_interunit: Resolve tax/prepaid/accrual first, then legacy interunit.
